correctness.rationale: Re-ran all 9 archived verifiers: all exit 0 with PASS lines. Exact-Q 512-subset Hochster sweep reproduces dim H^p = {0:1,5:4,7:3,8:10,9:3,10:4,11:13,12:21,13:21,14:8}, H^3=H^4=H^6=0, total 88. Full 1-skeleton follows from all 15 minimal non-faces having size>=3 (verified) so every |I|<=2 subcomplex is a simplex: H^3=0 hand-proof sound. Theorem A dichotomy (zero-quadruple Massey set either non-singleton or {0} with phi(0)=0) handles both cases without overclaiming the set equals {0}. Lemma S support argument verified: all 61 nonempty homology supports have |I|>=3 (independently recomputed), all 46 |J|<=2 subsets have H^{>0}(Z_{K_J})=0; 4x3=12>9 counting sound under stated Hochster-split support convention. Exhaustive scan independently recomputed: exactly 0 disjoint quadruples and exactly 1 disjoint triple ({123},{456},{789}) among C(61,3)/C(61,4) combos; max-disjoint backtrack certifies size 3. Degree gap: lowest positive degree 5 and top 14 established by exhaustive sweep (no reliance on cap remark); standard Massey degree sum|xi|-n+2 gives min 4-fold degree 18>14, so every defined value lands in zero group with phi(m)=0. Triple sharpness 5+5+5-1=14 with H^14=Q^8 confirmed. Transcription audit reproduces ORDERED_MATCH 15/15 against archived e-print source. Facet recount confirms 39 facets (34x5-sets, 5x6-sets) and dim-5 flag, which is honestly disclosed as non-load-bearing. Overlapping H^5 cup vanishing correctly invokes Baskakov disjointness rule as lemma; disjoint pairs certified by acyclic unions (recomputed). DRAFT mentions Euler/mod-p crosschecks whose separate scripts are not archived, but headline theorems do not depend on them and are covered by archived low-degree, second-engine, and support-lemma checks plus independent audit recomputation.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp-only. Limonchenko-Panov arXiv:2201.12779 (verified abs + archived TeX) decides only trivial cup and one triple Massey at K0; TeX grep finds no 4-fold, no Sullivan differential, no H^3-vanishing or degree-gap table. Grbic-Linton arXiv:1911.07083 (submitted 2019, v3 Jun 2021, predating Jan 2022 K0) gives general n-Massey join/star-deletion machinery for arbitrary classes but contains no K0 minimal-nonface list and no 4-fold at K0; general existence does not imply the obstructed conjunction here. Amelotte-Briggs arXiv:2506.15457 proves formality for the almost-quasi-Koszul class; K0 is non-formal by its triple, hence outside that class. No source logs an obstructed/defined 4-fold, an H^3=0 table, a min-support-3 census, or an 18>14 gap at K0. Internal prior scan corroborates: closest validated hit is a triple on an unrelated 2-complex. The impossibility/degree-gap boundary is absent from all checked sources.

Decides the disjoint-support Massey hierarchy at K0 sharply at order 3 with mathematical interpretation, not an unexplained enumeration; headline obstruction judged separately from any unfinished census. Genuinely arose from target pursuit (same K0, answers existence question definitively as impossible, retains counterexample_boundary mode) rather than a convenient replacement.
